title: It's Not a Good Foam Mattress
text: It's Not a Good Foam Mattress. Poor construction and low quality foam. Easily-tearable cover and foam.  Quite disappointed.

product_metadata.title: Treaton, Foam Mattress 7-Inch Medium Firm Tight top High Density Foam Mattress, Queen, Gray
features: BUILT FOR COMFORT: Our Medium Firm tight top mattress with high-density foam absorbs pressure and spreads it evenly, reducing back pain issues.
TIGHT TOP MATTRESS: The Medium Firm Tight Top is just what you need to sleep peacefully and is known to reduce spine alignment issues.
BED IN A BOX: We compress and roll into one convenient box for fast shipping, and to fit narrow doorways, and staircases without damages.
HIGHLY COMPATIBLE: The foam mattress goes with a range of bed frames and foundations to accommodate your needs.
AGES: It also goes with different age group like adult, Teen, Senior etc.
INSTALLATION: Allow the mattress to fully expand for at least 2 days before use.
description: Treaton presents you with the perfect foam mattress for a more comfortable, better nights sleep – Treaton Medium Firm Tight Top Foam Mattress. Its high-density foam absorbs pressure and spreads it evenly, drastically reducing back pain issues, which will help you enjoy a comfortable sleep on this beautifully designed foam mattress. It conforms to and supports your individual body shape, relieving pressure points and helping you relax. Just place this mattress on your bed frame, to transform your night to a pleasant sleep without tossing and turning. It goes beautifully with any platform bed, trundle bed, or your favorite bed frame. It is available in the assorted sizes of Twin, Twin XL, Full, Full XL, Queen, King, California King and some special sizes to accommodate your needs. This mattress-in-a-box, we compress and roll into one convenient box for fast shipping, and to fit narrow doorways, and staircases without damages. The foam mattress will give your room a neat, classy look. So, you can sooner enjoy your beauty sleep with our mattress.
